decisions.reason: The portable reference-class electrometer was launched only a year ago and featured on the home page, so its prospects are still uncertain, keeping it costs little, and it fits the firm's core dosimetry business, which makes the option worth holding open.

The oncology risk management software is a newer and less certain option outside the firm's core hardware business, but software costs little to keep on the market and one year of results does not show its value to be unrealizable, so it stays while uncertainty resolves.
